text.p: Eastbrokers International said Wednesday that effective immediately, Peter Schmid, the original founder of Eastbrokers AG, will become chairman of the board, president and chief executive officer.

Schmid, already president, replaces Michael Sumichrast, the company's chairman since its inception, who will remain a director and chairman of the compensation and audit committees. He also replaces August de Roode, who has left the company to pursue other interests.
Martin Sumichrast, former chief financial officer, will take the newly created position of vice-chairman of the board.
Kevin McNeil, comptroller, will become chief financial officer and treasurer and Dr. Falko Muller-Tyl, European financial director, will become chief operating officer.
Eastbrook also said Wednesday that it has acquired Financial Planning Services - International Inc, a California based NASD member firm, which has changed its name Eastbrokers North America Inc.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company said the acquisition is intended to complement its European operations by marketing its services to the U.S. institutional investment community.
Eastbrokers is a diversified investment banking and brokerage network, with offices in Austria, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Russia and eight eastern European nations.
